meaning:
1) span
1a) a unit of measure, approx half-cubit, or the distance from the thumb to the little finger on an outstretched hand

renderings.bsb: with the span of his hand

elsewhere.note: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and…
“These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border…
